title: Agent Onboarding Mode
description: How a seller onboards buyer agents for one billing party or for sandbox access. Absent means undeclared, never invite_only.

enumDescriptions.open: A buyer agent that meets every listed requirement and whose identity the seller can establish from the agent's published keys (the Web Bot Auth profile) may proceed without prior contact. open binds identity, not spend: spend still needs an existing billing relationship with the billed party, and a brand outside the buyer's operator domain needs a grant. A seller that only maps opaque, seller-issued credentials MUST NOT declare open.
enumDescriptions.application: The buyer completes an out-of-band step at url before the seller recognizes it for this mode.
enumDescriptions.invite_only: The seller does not accept unsolicited buyer agents for this mode. url MAY be absent.
